description: DISP-01 end to end, gate 2: an offer exists and a lifetime figure is on file, but there is only ONE thing to sell — the diagnostic routes to money-model-designer, the gap is tapped, and the specialist's grounded memo lands at the Approve gate. The same three dispatch observables as 29, on a different route, so the attribution assertion cannot be satisfied by a hardcoded string.
turns: Context on my business to keep on file: the Northwind logistics platform. What we sell is a done-for-you shipment onboarding package — that is our attraction offer, the front door customers buy first. Lifetime gross profit per customer (LTGP) is about 3200 dollars.
Nothing at all is sold after that: no upsell, no downsell, no recurring plan. Warm outreach is the one channel we run and it keeps us full.
That's everything. Now evaluate my business using my vault and what I've told you.
